title: UBIFS abnormal read-only investigation
goal: Identify and fix the verified cause of the UBIFS read-only transition without hiding real media errors.
current_behavior: Under the declared write stress, the filesystem can remount read-only after an I/O error chain.
expected_behavior: The original reproducible condition no longer causes a false read-only transition and true uncorrectable errors remain visible.
acceptance_criteria: Target reproduction completes without false read-only transition
True uncorrectable ECC negative case remains fail-closed
constraints: Keep the change scoped to the confirmed error-mapping path
approval_policy: Any target device write requires explicit human approval.
blocker_policy: Stop if source, board, firmware or device identity cannot be confirmed.
